2.1.q: Besides activities and their ordering, a process description may also include:
o: Products, roles, and pre- and post-conditions
2.1.vi: Process description: hoạt động, thứ tự; có thể thêm products, roles, pre/post-conditions.
2.1.en: Process descriptions: activities, ordering; may add products, roles, pre/post-conditions.

2.1.q: Which is a CURRENT/FUTURE trend in software processes?
2.1.vi: Xu hướng mới: mọi thứ kết nối, requirement đổi nhanh, adaptive process.
2.1.en: Current trends: everything connected, rapid requirements change, adaptive processes.

2.1.q: Which characteristic belongs to agile approaches?
o: Planning is incremental and relies on tacit knowledge
Progress is measured against a fixed plan
All activities are planned in advance
2.1.vi: Agile: kế hoạch dần dần, tacit knowledge, process nhẹ. Plan-driven: theo kế hoạch, tài liệu, process nặng.
2.1.en: Agile: incremental planning, tacit knowledge, light. Plan-driven: plan, documents, heavy.

2.1.q: In the lecture, Spiral is classified as:
2.1.vi: Plan-driven: Waterfall, Incremental, Spiral, RUP. Agile: XP, Scrum, Kanban.
2.1.en: Plan-driven: Waterfall, Incremental, Spiral, RUP. Agile: XP, Scrum, Kanban.

2.1.q: In which activity do customers and engineers define the software and its operational constraints?
2.1.vi: Specification: định nghĩa phần mềm và ràng buộc vận hành.
2.1.en: Specification: define the software and its operational constraints.

2.2.q: Which is a key idea of software process improvement?
o: Standardize good practices and measure performance
Change the whole process every sprint
2.2.vi: Đánh giá process, tìm điểm yếu, chuẩn hoá thực hành tốt, đo hiệu quả, dùng mô hình như CMMI.
2.2.en: Evaluate, find weaknesses, standardize good practices, measure, apply models like CMMI.

2.2.vi: SEI (CMU) phát triển; nay CMMI Institute (ISACA) duy trì, V3.0 (2023).
2.2.en: Developed by SEI (CMU); now maintained by the CMMI Institute (ISACA), V3.0 (2023).

2.2.q: Which CMMI level is "unpredictable and reactive; work is often delayed and over budget"?
2.2.vi: Level 1 Initial: bị động, khó dự đoán, hay trễ và vượt ngân sách.
2.2.en: Level 1 Initial: reactive, unpredictable, often late and over budget.

2.2.q: At which CMMI level do organization-wide standards guide projects, programs and portfolios?
2.2.vi: Level 3 Defined: chủ động, chuẩn toàn tổ chức.

2.2.q: Which CMMI level focuses on continuous improvement?
2.2.vi: Level 5 Optimizing: ổn định, linh hoạt, cải tiến liên tục.
2.2.en: Level 5 Optimizing: stable, flexible, continuous improvement.

2.2.q: CMMI was originally developed by CMU's SEI. SEI stands for:
2.2.vi: SEI = Software Engineering Institute (của CMU). Nay CMMI do CMMI Institute (ISACA) duy trì.
2.2.en: SEI = (CMU's) Software Engineering Institute. CMMI is now maintained by the CMMI Institute (ISACA).

2.3.vi: Plan-driven còn gọi là disciplined hoặc traditional methods.
2.3.en: Plan-driven methods are also called disciplined or traditional methods.

2.3.q: In the waterfall diagram, which stage comes LAST?
2.3.vi: Requirements → Analysis & Design → Implementation & Unit Testing → Integration & System Testing → Operation & Maintenance.
2.3.en: Requirements → Analysis & Design → Implementation & Unit Testing → Integration & System Testing → Operation & Maintenance.

2.3.q: In waterfall, how is a stage judged complete?
o: A set of criteria is met, checked with checklists
The next stage has already started
2.3.vi: Stage xong khi đạt bộ tiêu chí, kiểm bằng checklist.
2.3.en: A stage is complete when criteria are met, checked with checklists.

2.3.q: Which is a standard outcome of a waterfall stage?
2.3.vi: Đầu ra: requirements docs, architecture doc, code và test cases, test results, user manual, training doc.
2.3.en: Outcomes: requirements docs, architecture doc, code and tests, test results, user manual, training doc.

2.3.q: Why is waterfall difficult to use for most business systems?
o: Few business systems have stable requirements
It cannot be used for large projects
2.3.vi: Waterfall chỉ hợp khi requirement rõ và ổn định; ít hệ thống kinh doanh như vậy.
2.3.en: Waterfall needs well-understood, stable requirements; few business systems have them.

o: Every later stage has feedback arrows to earlier stages
2.3.vi: Waterfall revised: mọi stage đều có mũi tên quay lại stage trước.
2.3.en: Revised waterfall: every stage has arrows back to earlier stages.

2.4.q: Which statement about process iteration is correct?
o: Iteration can be applied to any of the generic process models
Iteration is only possible in Scrum
Iteration means doing all stages at once
2.4.vi: Iteration áp dụng được cho mọi process model chung; làm lại ở vòng sau.
2.4.en: Iteration can be applied to any generic process model; rework in later iterations.

2.4.q: In the incremental model diagram, each build contains:
2.4.vi: Mỗi build có Analysis & Design → Implementation → Testing.
2.4.en: Each build has Analysis & Design → Implementation → Testing.

2.4.q: Which is a BENEFIT of the incremental model?
o: Highest-priority requirements tend to receive the most testing
The process is very visible to managers
2.4.vi: Lợi ích: chức năng sớm, increment đầu như prototype, requirement ưu tiên cao được test nhiều, giảm rủi ro.
2.4.en: Benefits: early functionality, early increments as prototypes, top requirements tested most, lower risk.

2.4.q: Which statement about the spiral model is correct?
o: Risks are assessed and resolved throughout the process
It has fixed phases like specification and design
It ignores risk until the end
Each spiral is one sprint of 2 weeks
2.4.vi: Spiral: mỗi vòng là một phase, không có phase cố định, rủi ro xử lý xuyên suốt.
2.4.en: Spiral: each loop is a phase, no fixed phases, risks handled throughout.

2.4.q: Which is a BENEFIT of the spiral model?
2.4.vi: Lợi ích: nhấn mạnh rủi ro, tốt cho dự án lớn, requirement linh hoạt, người dùng thấy sớm. Nhược: phức tạp, đắt, khó quản lý thời gian.
2.4.en: Benefits: risk focus, large projects, flexible requirements, users see it early. Problems: complex, expensive, hard time management.

2.5.q: In RUP, the Construction phase covers:
2.5.vi: Inception: business case · Elaboration: domain + kiến trúc · Construction: thiết kế, code, test · Transition: triển khai.
2.5.en: Inception: business case · Elaboration: domain + architecture · Construction: design, code, test · Transition: deploy.

2.5.q: Deploying the system in its operating environment happens in which RUP phase?
2.5.vi: Transition: triển khai hệ thống vào môi trường vận hành.
2.5.en: Transition: deploy into the operating environment.

2.5.q: In the RUP diagram, Business Modeling, Requirements and Test are examples of:
2.5.vi: Chiều dọc là workflows (disciplines); chiều ngang là 4 phase chia thành iteration.
2.5.en: Vertical axis: workflows (disciplines); horizontal: four phases split into iterations.

2.5.q: What does each RUP iteration have to control when it starts and finishes?
2.5.vi: Mỗi iteration là một chu kỳ waterfall, có entry/exit criteria.
2.5.en: Each iteration is a waterfall cycle with entry and exit criteria.

2.5.vi: RUP = Rational Unified Process: Inception → Elaboration → Construction → Transition.
2.5.en: RUP = Rational Unified Process: Inception → Elaboration → Construction → Transition.

2.6.q: Complete the Agile value: "Customer collaboration over ___".
Complete the Agile value: "Individuals and interactions over ___".
2.6.vi: Individuals and interactions over processes and tools.
2.6.en: Individuals and interactions over processes and tools.

2.6.q: Which is one of the 12 Agile principles?
o: Working software is the primary measure of progress
Comprehensive documentation is the primary measure of progress
Requirements must be frozen before coding
Teams should work overtime to meet deadlines
2.6.vi: Nguyên tắc: phần mềm chạy được là thước đo tiến độ chính; nhịp độ bền vững.
2.6.en: Principle: working software is the primary measure of progress; sustainable pace.

2.6.q: According to the Agile principles, the best architectures emerge from:
2.6.vi: Kiến trúc tốt nhất đến từ team tự tổ chức.
2.6.en: The best architectures emerge from self-organizing teams.

2.7.q: XP's answer to "if integration testing is important" is to:
o: Integrate and test several times a day
2.7.vi: XP đẩy thực hành tốt lên cực đoan: tích hợp và test nhiều lần mỗi ngày.
2.7.en: XP pushes good practices to extremes: integrate and test several times a day.

2.7.q: In XP, how involved should the customer be?
2.7.vi: XP: khách là thành viên toàn thời gian (On-site Customer).
2.7.en: XP: the customer is a full-time participant (On-site Customer).

2.7.q: Which IS one of the 12 XP practices?
2.7.vi: 12 practice XP gồm 40-hour Week, Pair Programming, Refactoring, Continuous Integration…
2.7.en: XP practices include 40-hour Week, Pair Programming, Refactoring, Continuous Integration…

2.7.q: XP's view of design simplicity is to:
o: Keep the simplest design that supports current functionality
Design every future feature up front
2.7.vi: Luôn giữ thiết kế đơn giản nhất đủ cho chức năng hiện tại.
2.7.en: Always keep the simplest design that supports current functionality.

2.7.vi: XP = Extreme Programming, một phương pháp Agile cùng với Scrum và Kanban.
2.7.en: XP = Extreme Programming, an agile method alongside Scrum and Kanban.

2.8.vi: Scrum do Ken Schwaber và Jeff Sutherland phát triển; Scrum Guide mới nhất 11/2020.
2.8.en: Scrum by Ken Schwaber and Jeff Sutherland; latest Scrum Guide Nov 2020.

2.8.q: The Sprint Goal is the commitment for:
2.8.vi: Product Backlog ↔ Product Goal · Sprint Backlog ↔ Sprint Goal · Increment ↔ Definition of Done.
2.8.en: Product Backlog ↔ Product Goal · Sprint Backlog ↔ Sprint Goal · Increment ↔ Definition of Done.

2.8.q: Which event contains all other Scrum events?
2.8.vi: Sprint: tối đa 1 tháng, chứa mọi event khác.
2.8.en: The Sprint: one month or less, containing all other events.

2.8.q: Which accountability creates a usable Increment every Sprint?
2.8.vi: Developers tạo Sprint Backlog và Increment dùng được mỗi Sprint.
2.8.en: Developers create the Sprint Backlog and a usable Increment every Sprint.

2.8.q: Inspecting the Increment with stakeholders and adapting the Product Backlog happens in:
2.8.vi: Review xem sản phẩm cùng stakeholder; Retrospective xem cách làm việc.
2.8.en: Review inspects the product with stakeholders; Retrospective inspects the way of working.

o: The Sprint Goal and the Sprint Backlog
2.8.vi: Sprint Planning trả lời Why/What/How, tạo Sprint Goal và Sprint Backlog.
2.8.en: Sprint Planning answers why/what/how and produces the Sprint Goal and Sprint Backlog.

2.8.q: Which is a good quality of user stories listed in the lecture?
2.8.vi: User story tốt: rõ ràng, nhỏ, test được, có giá trị; viết từ góc nhìn người dùng.
2.8.en: Good stories: clear, small, testable, valuable; from the user's view.

2.9.vi: Taiichi Ohno (Toyota) dùng Kanban để tránh nút thắt, tăng năng suất.
2.9.en: Taiichi Ohno (Toyota) used Kanban to avoid bottlenecks and raise productivity.

2.9.q: On a Kanban board, cards move:
2.9.vi: Mỗi thẻ là một work item, di chuyển từ trái sang phải; flow nên đều.
2.9.en: Each card is one work item, moved left to right; flow should be even.

2.9.q: "Start with what you are doing now" is one of Kanban's:
2.9.vi: 4 nguyên tắc: bắt đầu từ cái đang làm, đổi từng bước, tôn trọng vai trò hiện tại, lãnh đạo ở mọi cấp.
2.9.en: Four principles: start with what you do now, incremental change, respect current roles, leadership at all levels.

2.9.q: In Kanban, limiting work in progress means:
o: Current work must be completed before taking a new item
Each sprint has a fixed number of stories
Only the manager can add cards
Work is planned one year ahead
2.9.vi: Limit WIP: giới hạn số việc đang làm, phải xong việc hiện tại mới nhận việc mới.
2.9.en: Limit WIP: cap current items; finish current work before taking new work.

o: The time an item takes from start to finish
The number of items in progress
The time of the Daily Scrum
2.9.vi: Cycle time: thời gian một item từ lúc bắt đầu tới lúc xong.
2.9.en: Cycle time: time an item takes from start to finish.

2.9.vi: WIP = Work in progress (việc đang làm). Kanban giới hạn WIP: làm xong việc hiện tại mới nhận việc mới.
2.9.en: WIP = Work in progress. Kanban limits WIP: finish current work before taking new work.
